newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Pre-qualification for Brazil CVRD auction starts.
newsitem.headline: Pre-qualification for Brazil CVRD auction starts.

text.p: As of today, consortia interested in bidding in the privatization auction of state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) can present the necessary documentation to qualify for the sell-off.
Interested investors have until April 24 to hand in the "pre-identification" documents to the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange clearing house.
As part of the requirements, consortia will have to present financial guarantees for three billion reais ($2.83 billion).
Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) is publishing today a prospectus and an instruction manual on how to compile the documentation.

A 45 percent block of CVRD voting shares will be sold April 29 for a minimum price of 3 billion reais ($2.83 billion) as a first step in the company's privatization. A staff and global offering will complete the privatization process.
The company as a whole has been valued at 10.361 billion reais ($9.77 billion).

Two consortia likely to bid at the auction are taking shape. One includes Brazil's largest steelmaker Companhia Siderurgica Nacional (CSN), Brazil's largest retail bank Bradesco and South African mining firm Gencor Ltd.
The other is grouped around Brazilian metal, cement and pulp group Votorantim, and is likely to include Japan's Nippon Steel and South Africa's Anglo-American Corp.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
